name: ponchik_tilt_masked_a
prompt: The FIRST image is a sprite sheet of 8 frames (2 rows x 4 columns, read left to right, top row first), all 8 frames are the same picture of the fat black-and-white tomcat Ponchik lying on his back and holding a barbell (a wooden stick with two bundles of tin cans tied with rope at its ends). Edit ONLY the masked area: redraw the arms and the barbell so the 8 frames become ONE smooth bench-press push from the lowest point up: frame 1: the barbell just above the chest under the chin, the elbows bent and dropped beside the body; frames 2-8 push up in small, EVEN steps; frame 8 is the top: the arms extended up but still a little bent at the elbows. IMPORTANT: Ponchik lies at an angle (his head is to the upper right, his hips to the lower left), so the barbell is NOT horizontal: it is parallel to his shoulders, at a right angle to the line from his hips to his head, tilted about 20 degrees: its LEFT end is HIGHER and its RIGHT end (on the side of his head) is LOWER. The tilt is the same in every frame. The two fists grip the stick at different heights following this tilt (the left fist higher than the right one), shoulder width apart, and both arms push the barbell up along the same tilted line, the barbell moves up without turning. The barbell keeps the same size as in the FIRST image in every frame and is fully visible, it never covers the face. The arms keep their natural length and thickness (short chubby arms, never stretched). Keep the head, the face (same grumpy expression), the body, the belly, the legs and the feet EXACTLY as they are in every frame. Colours, fur and line weight exactly like the SECOND reference. Keep the solid flat pure chroma-key GREEN (#00FF00) background everywhere, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame numbers.
